title: Munich Deep Tech Demo Day: Autumn Batch
text:
Munich Deep Tech Demo Day, Autumn Batch. Hosted by Sara Okafor (Munich Deep Tech Network). 18 September 2026, Werk1, Munich.

Pitching team: Kelvio. Lena Müller (CEO, PhD candidate at the TUM Chair of Energy Systems) and Jonas Weber (CTO) build modular high-temperature thermal storage that lets factories run process heat on cheap renewable power. "We just started our first pilot with a brewery in Freising." Doors 17:30, pitches 18:00, drinks after.

title: EXIST-Gründerstipendium für vier TUM-Teams
text: Four TUM teams receive the EXIST Business Start-up Grant this autumn. Among them: Kelvio. Lena Mueller and Jonas Weber from the Chair of Energy Systems develop thermal batteries that store renewable electricity as heat at up to 600 °C for industrial customers. "With EXIST we can build our first 1 MWh unit and found the company next spring," says Lena Mueller.

title: Munich Startup Podcast #42: Designing proteins at LMU
text:
[00:41] Speaker 1: Welcome back. Today I'm with Aylin Kaya, a postdoc at the LMU Gene Center.
[03:15] Speaker 2: At Synthera we use diffusion models to design enzymes that break down industrial plastics.
[07:52] Speaker 2: Two chemical companies are testing our first enzymes in their labs right now.
[12:04] Speaker 2: We're looking for a technical co-founder who knows ML infrastructure.
[12:30] Speaker 1: If that's you, get in touch!

title: TUM.ai Makeathon 2026: Final Pitches & Winners
text: TUM.ai Makeathon 2026, final pitches. Jury: partners from three Munich VCs. 1st place: Gripr, a vision and gripper system that picks mixed parts out of unstructured bins for small manufacturers. Team: Maximilian Huber (robotics PhD, TUM), Sofia Rossi (ex-Siemens product manager), Tim Becker. In their pitch: "After the makeathon we're planning to raise a pre-seed round."

title: Praktikum Mobile Health Apps (WS26): Zwischenpräsentationen
text: Praktikum Mobile Health Apps, WS 2026/27, Lehrstuhl für Medieninformatik, LMU. Supervised by the chair. Student teams present their interim projects. Team 3: MediMate, a medication reminder app for elderly patients, by Paul Fischer and Hannah Wolf. Final presentations in February, grading by the chair.
